privacy.title: Privacy Policy.
privacy.description: At {companyName}, we take your privacy seriously. This Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you use our website or engage with our services.
privacy.contentHtml:
1. Information We Collect

We may collect the following types of information when you interact with us:

  • Personal Data: Name, email address, phone number, and company details when you submit a contact form or request a quote.
  • Usage Data: Information about how you navigate our website, including IP address, browser type, and operating system, collected via cookies and analytics tools.

Optional analytics tools are loaded only after cookie consent. We do not intentionally send names, email addresses, phone numbers, form requirements, or raw search terms to analytics tools.

2. How We Use Your Information

We use the collected information for the following purposes:

  • To provide and maintain our engineering and export services.
  • To communicate with you regarding quotes, projects, and support.
  • To improve our website functionality and user experience.
  • To comply with legal and regulatory requirements.

3. Data Protection and Security

We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your personal data from unauthorized access, alteration, or disclosure. However, no internet transmission is entirely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

4. Third-Party Sharing

We do not sell your personal data. We may share necessary information with trusted third-party service providers (e.g., shipping partners, analytics providers) solely to facilitate our services. These partners are bound by strict confidentiality agreements.

5. Your Rights

Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have the right to access, update, or delete your personal data. To exercise these rights, please contact us at {email}.

6. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or legal obligations. The "Last Updated" date will indicate the latest revision.

7. Contact Us

If you have any questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at:

highlights.title: ISRO Gaganyaan Mission
highlights.subtitle: Strategic Aerospace Engineering

showcase.heroDescription: Manufacturing the capsule entry and deboarding mechanism for India's pioneering Gaganyaan space mission.
showcase.challengeDescription: When ISRO required a reliable, precision-engineered mechanism for astronaut movement, they didn't just need a vendor—they needed an engineering partner capable of indigenous innovation. The ask: A robust capsule entry, crew onboarding, and deboarding lander mechanism manufactured for the extreme demands of the Gaganyaan program. Every millimeter of movement had to be perfectly orchestrated, ensuring absolute safety for India's first manned space flight.

categories.title: Acoustic Windows
categories.description: Engineered aluminum systems for high-performance sound isolation in residential and professional environments.
categories.summary: Sliding, Casement, and Vertical Sash systems.

faqs.q: What sound reduction range do your acoustic windows cover?
faqs.a: The verified catalog describes acoustic window assemblies from roughly STC 30 dB to 52 dB, depending on the selected system and glazing build-up.

faqs.q: Where are acoustic windows typically specified?
faqs.a: They are commonly specified for residential applications, commercial centers, industrial establishments, multiplexes, malls, theaters, and conference halls.

extendedContent: ### Complete Specification Guide: Soundproof Windows

Specifying the correct acoustic fenestration requires balancing Sound Transmission Class (STC) targets with aesthetic and structural requirements. Kiran Slido Craft manufactures highly engineered soundproof windows designed to combat urban, rail, and industrial noise pollution. The verified window catalog describes aluminum extrusion, insulated glass, and insulation materials, with sound-blocking performance from STC 30 dB to 52 dB depending on the selected system.
**Selection Criteria & STC Considerations:**

When selecting an acoustic window, the primary metric is the STC rating. The supplied technical table lists single pane windows around STC 25-28, double pane windows around STC 28-35, soundproof windows combined with single pane windows around STC 41-45, soundproof windows combined with double pane windows around STC 44-48, and two soundproof windows plus a single pane window around STC 50-58. Site requirements should be matched to the measured noise source, facade condition, and target reduction.
**Hardware and Acoustic Sealing:**

Glass alone does not stop sound - air leaks are the primary cause of acoustic failure. The window system is built around insulated aluminum sections, double-glass assemblies, and custom profiles available from regular to slim series, with manual to motorized sliding options.
**Project Fit and Installation:**

These systems are specified for residential applications, commercial centers, industrial establishments, multiplexes, malls, theaters, and conference halls. Finish options include anodized and polyester powder-coated colors, with color matched to the client's requirement.

categories.title: Acoustic Partitions
categories.description: Architectural partition systems designed for flexible space management with superior sound transmission control.
categories.summary: Movable and fixed acoustic wall systems.

faqs.q: What acoustic performance do the movable partition systems achieve?
faqs.a: The verified W Type movable partition profile documents laboratory acoustic performance around STC 55-56 dB, using nominal 100 mm thick panels with acoustic infill and sealed interfaces.

faqs.q: Which finishes are available for acoustic partitions?
faqs.a: Verified finish options include MDF, steel face, carpet fabric, wood veneer, laminate, canvas, tapestry or fabric, and other custom finishes.

extendedContent: ### Complete Specification Guide: Acoustic Partitions

Acoustic partitions are critical for dynamic space management in corporate, hospitality, and institutional environments. Our movable acoustic partitions deliver exceptional sound transmission loss while allowing rapid reconfiguration of large spaces.
**Engineering & Performance:**

The supplied W Type movable partition profile documents laboratory acoustic performance around STC 55-56 dB, with nominal 100 mm thick panels and single seamless panels available up to 18 meters high. The system uses 2 mm welded heavy-duty galvanized steel frames, acoustic infill, galvanized steel faces, and tongue-and-groove vertical seals to prevent panel-to-panel sound leaks.
**Track and Carriage Systems:**

A partition is only as good as its mobility and seal. The verified profile uses top-supported track systems in architectural-grade aluminum alloy 6063-T6, with optional steel track where height or weight exceeds aluminum track limits. Dual-wheel carriers with precision-ground bearings allow panels to negotiate 90-degree turns, X, L, and T intersections for flexible parking layouts.
**Acoustic Sealing Mechanisms:**

To achieve laboratory-rated STC performance in the field, the system uses four-finger sweep seals, top and bottom retractable seals, and crank-down mechanical operation by removable handle. The profile documents 25 mm nominal top operating clearance and 38 mm nominal bottom clearance to accommodate normal floor gradient, with final closure panels using an expandable jamb to tighten the partition for optimum acoustics.
**Maintenance and Finish Options:**

Finish options verified from the supplied PDFs include MDF, steel face, carpet fabric, wood veneer, laminate, canvas, tapestry or fabric, and other custom finishes. Unfinished panels can also be supplied for field-applied finishes.

categories.title: Acoustic Doors
categories.description: Precision-engineered door systems for machinery enclosures, recording studios, and commercial facilities.
categories.summary: Sliding, swing, and bifold acoustic doors.

faqs.q: What STC range do your acoustic doors cover?
faqs.a: The engineered door systems are designed to achieve STC ratings from 42 to 55+, depending on the acoustic target and application.

faqs.q: Do the door systems include engineered seals and frames?
faqs.a: Yes. The door sets use engineered frames with perimeter compression seals and automatic drop-down bottom seals, with cam-lift or heavy-duty hinge options.

extendedContent: ### Complete Specification Guide: Acoustic Doors

Standard solid-core doors fail to provide adequate acoustic isolation for sensitive environments like recording studios, theaters, or heavy industrial plant rooms. Our engineered acoustic doors are designed to block the full spectrum of frequencies, achieving STC ratings from 42 to 55+.
**Material and Core Construction:**

Depending on the acoustic target and application, we manufacture both acoustic wood and acoustic steel doors. The internal structure features constrained layer damping, utilizing alternating layers of high-density acoustic insulation, mass-loaded barriers, and decoupling layers. This dense composite structure effectively absorbs low-frequency vibrations and blocks high-frequency transmission.
**The Importance of Acoustic Frames and Seals:**

An acoustic door must be installed as a complete system with its engineered frame. Sound behaves like water—it will exploit the smallest air gap. Our door sets feature proprietary frames with integrated perimeter compression seals. We utilize cam-lift hinges or heavy-duty hinges combined with automatic drop-down bottom seals. As the door closes, the drop seal mechanically lowers to compress against the threshold, creating an airtight acoustic barrier.
**Specialized Applications:**

For recording studios and audiometry rooms, we offer tandem (double-door) configurations to achieve maximum isolation. For industrial applications, our heavy-duty acoustic steel doors provide fire-rating alongside noise control, protecting personnel from machinery noise. All hardware, from multi-point locks to acoustic vision panels, is pre-installed to ensure factory-tested performance.

categories.title: Automation Systems
categories.description: Advanced motorized solutions for security gates, barriers, vertical sliding systems, and specialized architectural movement.
categories.summary: Telescopic gates, barriers, vertical sliding systems, and soundproof automation.

faqs.q: Are your motorized gates and roofs safe for daily use?
faqs.a: Every system is equipped with active infrared safety sensors and auto-reverse mechanisms. They comply with international safety standards to prevent accidental closure or entrapment.

faqs.q: Can these systems be integrated with my existing smart home or BMS?
faqs.a: Yes. Our automation controllers support standard protocols for integration with Crestron, Control4, and most industrial Building Management Systems (BMS).

extendedContent: ### Complete Specification Guide: Architectural Automation

Kiran Slido Craft brings aerospace-grade precision to architectural movement. Our motorized automation systems are designed for high-security compounds, industrial facilities, and premium residential estates requiring heavy-duty, reliable operation.
**Motorized Sliding and Telescopic Gates:**

For properties with limited side clearance, our motorized telescopic gates are the definitive solution. These multi-leaf systems stack compactly, maximizing the clear opening. Powered by heavy-duty, oil-immersed gear motors, these gates are built to handle continuous operational cycles. They feature soft-start and soft-stop functionality, extending mechanical lifespan and ensuring silent operation.
**Advanced Control and Safety Integration:**

All our motorized systems integrate seamlessly with modern access control, including RFID, biometric, ALPR (Automated License Plate Recognition), and smart home protocols. Safety is paramount; our systems are equipped with active infrared photoelectric beams and safety edge sensors that instantly reverse the motor upon detecting an obstruction, complying with strict international safety standards.
**Vertical Sliding Systems:**

Beyond horizontal movement, we specialize in motorized vertical sliding systems. These are utilized for counterweights, architectural glazing, and security partitions where horizontal space is unavailable. Utilizing precision guide rails, counterweight balancing, and failsafe braking mechanisms, these systems provide effortless vertical movement for massive architectural elements.

categories.title: Retractable Roofs
categories.description: Custom motorized sliding roof systems for luxury terraces, atriums, and commercial spaces.
categories.summary: Motorized sliding roofs in SS and Aluminum.

faqs.q: What frame and glazing options are available for retractable roofs?
faqs.a: Verified options include aluminum extrusion or stainless steel framework, with glass or polycarbonate sheet options in 8 mm or 10 mm depending on the project requirement.

faqs.q: Are the roof systems motorized and weather protected?
faqs.a: Yes. The supplied system is described as weatherproof, dust proof, and IP rated, with a 240 V motor, controller, remote handset, and overload protection.

extendedContent: ### Complete Specification Guide: Motorized Retractable Roofs

Motorized sliding roofs transform indoor environments into open-air spaces at the push of a button. The supplied roof system PDF identifies Kiran Slido Craft as a manufacturer, exporter, and supplier of insulated retractable sliding glass roof systems for commercial buildings, restaurants, cafes, sport halls, private houses, public buildings, pool covers, skylights, and similar custom applications.
**Structural Engineering and Glazing:**

Verified frame options are aluminum extrusion or stainless steel framework. The roof PDF lists aluminum 6000 series and stainless steel 204 box pipe details, with glass or polycarbonate sheet options in 8 mm or 10 mm depending on customer requirement.
**Motorization and Track Design:**

The technical specification lists a 240 V single-phase motor with controller and one remote handset, IP-rated and CE-certified motor options, overheat and overload protection, 40% duty cycle, and chain-sprocket drive mechanism. Indian-made heavy-duty cycle motors or imported European-standard motors are available depending on the project requirement.
**Weather Sealing and Automation:**

The roof system is described as weatherproof, dust proof, and IP rated. Available formats include double slide and single slide, with common configurations such as 25% fixed / 75% sliding and 50% fixed / 50% sliding. Prefabricated custom sizing helps reduce on-site installation time compared with conventional roof-window construction.
